items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: Well, me and Lacey Collins used to play together. Well, Lacey Collins learned me a lot of his notes

ctx.x: All right. All right. All right. What about, uh, did you ever hear a fella called Lacey Collins from that?

Well, me and Lacey Collins used to play together. Well, Lacey Collins learned me a lot of his notes, you see. And Lacey Collins just absolutely, he could pick a guitar. He just sat down there and put his cap over his eye. He wouldn't pat his feet or nothing. Just stretch his feet right out before him. And just, just absolutely, he didn't forget guitars, well I may say. But he really could play. He could play a guitar. But he finally, uh, died. He was a guitar player and a big gambler. And I loved his music. I…
And your sister's playing piano now? Oh, yes, sir.
